events.notes: Level set to MAJOR by analogy with the Olympics/World Championships tier in rules.json; the Asian Games isn't a BWF Tour event so it has no official tier name of its own. Men's team: India beat Bangladesh (R16) and Japan (QF), lost to China (SF) and won bronze; per this format semifinal losers are awarded bronze directly, with no separate third-place match (none is shown in the source). Women's team: India beat Kazakhstan (R16), lost to Japan (QF) and were eliminated without a medal (only semifinal losers medal in this format). Un-played rubbers after a tie was already decided are omitted, same convention as bye handling elsewhere in this file.
